policy.promotion: exact DAT state root, recursively complete present DRS SLP chain containing a body layer >=20, stable layer order, accumulated offsets, per-player palette decode, compatible frame cadence
policy.construction: all audited construction roots resolve only layer-10 art; none is promoted as a body composition
policy.damage: runtime selector uses 100-floor(hp*100/maxhp), strict threshold comparison, flag 0/1 attachment overlays, and flag 2 standing-graphic replacement; flag 1 randomized offset records are excluded unless deterministic placement is independently proved
